Perks › Epic

Wild Blank

Epic perk · Placement

Your blanks may match any open end.

In-game card text

How it works

Your blank bones may be played on any open end. A blank half matches whatever number it touches; the other half stays as printed.

  • The double blank takes the end's value on both halves (0-0 played on a 3 plays as a 3-3).
  • It is permanent and needs no arming. Extra copies change nothing.
  • Counterfeit Pip is the one-use version.
